description.en: Connects CNB (cnb.cool) models to DSH: scan-to-sign-in, repository and cloud-native workspace management, and one-click wiring of the cloud-hosted gateway into llm-pi-ai, with image input enabled by default and each model at its measured context and output limits.
description.zh: 把 CNB（cnb.cool）的模型接进 DSH：扫码登录、仓库与云原生开发环境管理，以及一键把云端网关写进 llm-pi-ai——默认开启图片输入，每个模型按实测的上下文与输出上限配置。
